g.text: $ algomotion export dijkstra --input 'A-B 4, B-C 1, A-C 7, C-D 2' --step 'extr
$ algomotion run dijkstra 'A-B 4, B-C 1, A-C 7, C-D 2' --out dijkstra.json
Frame 7 of 0–14 · improve#3 · at improve (pseudocode line 11, python line 11)
narration: 4 + 1 = 5 < 7: C improves to 5, through B.
INVALID_NOTATION at $.input: Expected a weight or "," after "B-C", not "x" (ch
aracter 12) (hint: Write edges separated by commas, e.g. "A-B 4, B-C 2": "-" j
oins an undirected edge and "->" a directed one, a weight goes after a space,
and a name alone is a node without edges; names are letters, digits and _.)
